title: Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising Game Launches Version 2.60, Switch 2 Version Simultaneously on September 17
content: Cygames revealed on Saturday at the EVO 2026 event the September 17 simultaneous release of the Version 2.60 and Nintendo Switch 2 version for its Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising fighting game. Cygames also revealed that the game's Version 2.60 will add the character Id, and started streaming a teaser video.
author: ANN

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Anime's 2nd Season Continues With 2nd Part in October
content: The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga revealed on Sunday that the anime's second season will continue with its second cours (quarter of a year) in October, and started streaming a teaser trailer.
author: ANN

title: Guilty Gear -Strive- Game Releases Full Trailer for DLC Character Robo-Ky
content: Arc System Works revealed at the EVO 2026 event on Saturday the trailer for upcoming DLC character Robo-Ky in its Guilty Gear -Strive- fighting game . English Trailer Japanese Trailer Robo-Ky will join the game as part of the season 5 pass on July 2.
author: ANN

title: 'Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria' Gets Third Season
content: • The 12th and final episode of Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria Season 2 ( Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 ) ended with an announcement that a third season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement promo and celebratory visual (pictured above).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Blazblue: CentralFiction Fighting Game Reveals New DLC Character Trinity Glassfille
content: Arc System Works America revealed the previously teased DLC character for its Blazblue: CentralFiction fighting game during the EVO 2026 event on Saturday. The company streamed a video for the new character Trinity Glassfille.
author: ANN

title: Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes Fighting Game Reveals Trailer for DLC Character Zohar The 'Doppelganger'
content: Arc System Works revealed the trailer for the new DLC character Zohar The "Doppelganger" for Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes , the newest installment in French Bread's original Under Night In-Birth 2D fighting game series, at the EVO 2026 event on Saturday. The character will launch in summer 2026.
author: ANN

title: Wit Studio Reveals LONA Original TV Anime by Director Takashi Katagiri Slated for Spring 2027 Debut
content: Wit Studio revealed on Sunday a new original television anime by director Takashi Katagiri ( SPY×FAMILY Code: White film) titled LONA ( Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis ), which will debut in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 3 Announced
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 3 was officially announced immediately after the second season’s finale finished airing in Japan. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide, with Episode 12 set to arrive soon.
author: Anime Corner

title: WIT STUDIO Announces Original TV Anime LONA for Spring 2027, Reveals Staff, Cast, and First Trailer
content: WIT STUDIO has officially announced its next original TV anime, LONA , which is scheduled to premiere in Spring 2027. The studio also released the anime’s first teaser trailer, teaser commercial, and three teaser visuals while revealing its main staff and cast.
author: Anime Corner

title: Shonen Jump’s Major 2026 Cancellation Officially Confirmed as a Huge Mistake
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine continues its wave of cancellations as it hits one of its most promising series. Alien Headbutt is Akira Inui’s first serialized manga, and while fans noticed the promising elements in the story, the magazine didn’t give it a chance to shine.
author: ComicBook
